description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for freshwater lake water samples collected across depths, locations, and seasons and processed for metagenomic sequencing.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual water sample record; must be stable and unambiguous (e.g., 'FLAKE_001_D5m_2024-06-12').

project_id.descr: Identifier for the study/project or sampling campaign that the sample belongs to.

lake_name.descr: Name of the freshwater lake where the sample was collected.

lake_id.descr: Optional standardized identifier for the lake, if available (e.g., site code or registry ID).

water_body_type.descr: Controlled term for the sampled water body; expected values include 'lake', 'pond', 'reservoir', or other freshwater types.

sampling_site_id.descr: Identifier for the specific location within the lake (e.g., station code).

geodetic_datum.descr: Geodetic reference system used for coordinates; e.g., 'WGS84'.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Depth at which the water sample was collected, in meters below water surface.

max_water_column_depth_m.descr: Total depth of the water column at the sampling location, in meters, if known.

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; controlled values may include 'spring', 'summer', 'autumn', 'winter'.

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_time_local.descr: Local time of sample collection, if recorded, preferably in 24-hour format.

timezone.descr: Time zone for the sampling time (e.g., 'UTC', 'Europe/Berlin').

sampling_replicate.descr: Replicate number for the sampling event, if multiple technical or field replicates were collected.

sample_matrix.descr: Physical matrix sampled; expected value for this study is typically 'water'.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of water collected for this sample, in liters.

water_temperature_c.descr: Water temperature measured at the sampling location, in degrees Celsius.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration, in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

dissolved_oxygen_percent_sat.descr: Dissolved oxygen as percent saturation, if measured.

ph.descr: Water pH measured at sampling time.

conductivity_uS_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity of the water, in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm).

turbidity_ntu.descr: Water turbidity, in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

secchi_depth_m.descr: Secchi disk depth, in meters, if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration, in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

nitrate_mg_l.descr: Nitrate concentration, in mg/L, as reported by the assay.

nitrite_mg_l.descr: Nitrite concentration, in mg/L, as reported by the assay.

ammonium_mg_l.descr: Ammonium concentration, in mg/L, as reported by the assay.

phosphate_mg_l.descr: Orthophosphate or soluble reactive phosphorus concentration, in mg/L, as reported by the assay.

total_nitrogen_mg_l.descr: Total nitrogen concentration, in mg/L, if measured.

total_phosphorus_mg_l.descr: Total phosphorus concentration, in mg/L, if measured.

sampled_by.descr: Name or identifier of the person or team that collected the sample.

collection_method.descr: Brief description of the sampling method/instrument used (e.g., Niskin bottle, grab sample).

filtered.descr: Whether the water sample was filtered before nucleic acid extraction.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used for sample processing, in micrometers (µm), if filtered.

filter_material.descr: Filter membrane material used (e.g., polycarbonate, cellulose nitrate, PES).

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample before extraction (e.g., flash-frozen, RNAlater, on ice).

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature before extraction, in degrees Celsius.

time_to_extraction_h.descr: Elapsed time between collection and nucleic acid extraction, in hours.

extraction_method.descr: Nucleic acid extraction protocol or kit used.

extraction_kit.descr: Commercial kit name and/or catalog identifier used for extraction, if applicable.

dna_yield_ng.descr: DNA yield obtained after extraction, in nanograms (ng).

rna_yield_ng.descr: RNA yield obtained after extraction, in nanograms (ng), if RNA was extracted.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing.

library_type.descr: Type of sequencing library prepared; e.g., metagenomic shotgun, paired-end DNA library.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing approach; expected value for this study is typically 'shotgun metagenomics'.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

paired_end.descr: Whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads.

barcode_index.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence identifier used for multiplexing.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or flow cell identifier.

raw_reads_count.descr: Total number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

qc_passed_reads_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality control/filtering.

assembly_method.descr: Assembly tool or protocol used for metagenomic assembly, if performed.

binning_method.descr: Binning tool or protocol used to recover MAGs, if performed.

taxonomic_classification_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic profiling/classification (e.g., Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, 16S not expected but may be referenced if used).

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method used for functional annotation of metagenomic data (e.g., HUMAnN, eggNOG-mapper).

contamination_check_performed.descr: Whether contamination screening or decontamination was performed on the sample or derived assemblies.

negative_control_used.descr: Whether extraction or library blank controls were included for this sample batch.

notes.descr: Free-text comments on anomalies, deviations from protocol, or sample-specific observations.
